ana_dev: Heads-up — opened a small PR to tweak the Python quickstart streaming section to call out concurrency behavior and a tiny example. can someone sanity-check? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

mike_docs: On it. quick Q: you added a note about `concurrency=3` — can you paste the exact snippet you want to include so I can review copy + code style?

ana_dev: Yep, here's the example I added:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# enable streaming and raise concurrency for parallel streams
resp = client.generate("Summarize the following...", streaming=True, concurrency=3)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```
Think this conveys the idea without extra ceremony.

liam_eng: Small nit: maybe add one sentence about ordering — `streaming=True` with concurrency can lead to interleaved partial chunks if you're aggregating client-side. Suggest: "Concurrency increases throughput by serving multiple inflight requests; partial streaming chunks may arrive out of per-request order unless you aggregate per session id."

ana_dev: Good call — I updated the PR text to: "Concurrency increases throughput by serving multiple inflight streams. Streaming emits partial chunks which may be interleaved across concurrent requests; to preserve per-request ordering, pin a session or aggregate by request id on the client." Also ran `make docs-lint` and fixed a couple of style warnings.

ci-bot: CI: docs-build ✅ — 1 warning, 0 errors. Link-check: missing anchor in the examples section. Details: https://ci.redwood/1234/build/567

mike_docs: I can patch the anchor quickly and push. will do in a minute.

tara: :thumbsup: I skimmed the new wording — approved from product POV. two tiny asks: (1) add a one-line changelog entry, (2) call out CPU implications for client-side aggregation (some users will buffer chunks).

ana_dev: Added changelog and a short note about CPU/memory on the client side when aggregating streams. Re-ran lint and link-check; all green now.

liam_eng: Looks good to me — approving.

mike_docs: LGTM — pushed the anchor fix and verified the link-check passes.

ana_dev: Thanks all! I'll merge in ~24 hours unless someone objects so folks have a chance to review. Appreciated.
